principle: Morphology is a property of phenotypes (Cap, Dev, Res) and of bounded mutual compilation, never of syntax or of a generator-side label. Signatures below are conjunctions of five label-free observables; no signature names a parent architecture.

theta_type.definition: type of the mutable state Theta_x = product of local states (D-1.5)

update_locality.definition: loc(x) = max over feedback events of |changed occurrences| / |Theta_x|; NONE: inert; LOCAL_O1: bounded by a constant; SPARSE: o(|Theta_x|); DENSE: Theta(|Theta_x|)

feedback_dependence.definition: fbdep(x) = feedback types under which Theta_x changes at all on the registered protocol; demonstration is folded into exact_counterexample (an (input, correct output) pair), membership/equivalence queries into query_access

execution_shape.definition: shape of the induced transition delta_x under the registered combinators

store_discipline.definition: organization of the part of Theta_x that grows with experience

M0_AUTOMATON.note: inert finite transducer; the base case every basis must generate (GMI-T1); learning-law-free

M1_PRODUCTION.note: typed working store + condition/action rules + conflict resolution; update = rule add/remove/reweight (chunking-shaped); Rete-class match cost is the exec coordinate (P8 ledger)

M2_PROGRAMMATIC.note: term + interpreter-as-composite + search-with-verifier update; universality is the trap (GMI-T8): the claim is the K-bounded compilation of the search law, never expressivity

M3_PROBABILISTIC.note: distribution over execution traces; update = conditioning (posterior proportional to prior x likelihood) realized by sample/score/normalize primitives; exact only where conditioning is computable (P6 ledger: Ackerman-Freer-Roy boundary)

M4_PARAMETRIC_GRADIENT.note: dense numeric parameters, affine+pointwise-nonlinear acyclic composition, update = every parameter moves per scalar-loss event by a locally computed request (Learn-category shape, P7 ledger). Named by observables, not by 'neuron'.

M5_MEMORY_RETRIEVAL.note: insert-and-lookup; distinguished from M1 by store discipline (exemplars vs rules) and from M4 by theta_type and locality; the grokking memorization phenotype (P9A ledger) sits here

M6_HYBRID.note: at least two signatures joined at an explicit proposal/verification boundary (DreamCoder / inference-compilation / neurosymbolic shape); membership requires that each sub-part alone would classify into a distinct class at the same (eps, K)

classification_rule: x in class k iff exists y with Sig_k(y) and x ~_(E,eps,K) y (D-5.3). Multiple memberships reported as HYBRID_OR_AMBIGUOUS; none as NOVELTY_CANDIDATE_AT_K. Classifier code frozen (hash) before any D6 search is designed; runs only post-hoc; receives no generator label.

tolerance_defaults_V1.K: declared per microscope; must be below K_sim(B) (D-6.2) or the row is UNIVERSAL_COMPUTATION_ONLY

parent_taxonomies_absorbed_not_adopted.Kotseruba-Tsotsos symbolic/emergent/hybr: syntactic classification of architectures; absorbed as a prior over signatures, not as a class definition (P8 ledger)
parent_taxonomies_absorbed_not_adopted.Hospedales meta-representation/optimizer: learning-law taxonomy within M4; absorbed into feedback_dependence + update_locality (P4 ledger)
parent_taxonomies_absorbed_not_adopted.ORION morphology zoo unit_types/field_fa: OCM-internal non-neural genome; each unit_type maps to a signature or a composite of signatures; the zoo cannot express M4 and therefore cannot answer the Track-B question as written (#377 §16)

relation_to_v1: Additive to MORPHOLOGY_CONTRACT_V1.json (Codex, 90a73ce1). V1 fields G/X/Theta/Pi/L/K and phenotype (Q,R,D,S) are kept; V2 makes the structural observable S a decidable 5-tuple and turns V1 known_form_hypotheses into label-free signatures.

coherence_constraints_frozen.why: no update means no feedback can change Theta; the converse is NOT required (self-organizing / Hebbian updates use no external feedback)
a parameter array is numeric by definition
touching Theta(|Theta|) coordinates per event on a growing exemplar/rule/term store contradicts the store discipline; dense updates act on fixed arrays or fixed state

classifier_discipline: Frozen (sha256 in FREEZE file) before any D6 search; runs post-hoc only; receives x and E only, never a generator label; multiple membership reported as HYBRID_OR_AMBIGUOUS; none as NOVELTY_CANDIDATE_AT_K.
